mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent decline in housing starts over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which can lead to a broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which can lead to increased economic output and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary environment, which is conducive to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in retail sales by more than 2% in a month signals a surge in consumer demand, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when RSAFS increases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2% each in a month signals a strengthening labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.2% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a strong economic growth, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 increases over two consecutive quarters.
